question: What controlling role is Bhairava asked to assume perpetually?
premises: Bhairava is addressed as the best of Bhairavas.
He is asked to be the restrainer always.
inference: The supreme Bhairava is petitioned to maintain constant restraining power.
uncertainties: The speaker of this request is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Indeed, always be the restrainer, O best of Bhairavas.
